speaker: Doctor
text: The blood work results you received indicate normal readings for your count and coagulation profile, which rules out common clotting factor deficiencies. Given your history of easy bruising and post-extraction bleeding, do you have any specific medications like aspirin, or have you ever noticed that your bleeding stops very slowly from small scrapes?

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your blood work and medication history are normal, and you are a young student, this presentation suggests an issue with platelet function rather than a clotting factor deficiency. Do you notice small red spots (petechiae) on your skin, particularly on your legs, or does the bleeding from your extraction site continue despite applying firm pressure?

REQUEST TEST: Bleeding_Time
REQUEST IMAGES: Dermatology_Petechiae

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hematologic tests show Bleeding Time of 6 min; Dermatologic examination reveals several old bruises of different ages on the extremities, but no active petechiae or new lesions noted on the skin.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The bleeding time of 6 minutes is prolonged (normal is typically 2-7 minutes, but in this context of easy bruising and post-extraction bleeding, it supports a functional defect), and the absence of petechiae makes immune thrombocytopenia less likely. Given your history of easy bruising and normal platelet count, do you notice a tendency for your nose or gums to bleed spontaneously, or do you experience heavy bleeding during your menstrual periods?

text: RESULTS: Coagulation Profile: Prothrombin Time 15 sec, Partial Thromboplastin Time 60 sec, Bleeding Time 6 min, Fibrin Split Products Negative; Platelet Function Assay: Abnormal (indicated by prolonged bleeding time and clinical context of easy bruising with normal count).

speaker: Doctor
text:
The prolonged aPTT alongside a normal PT and normal platelet count points toward a factor deficiency, likely Hemophilia A or B, given your history of easy bruising and bleeding after extraction. To differentiate between these two factor deficiencies, I need to see the results of the specific factor assays.
